turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Heading to Portugal for two weeks and I'm terrified of the roaming bill.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Understandable. Would you rather buy your carrier's travel pass, or get a local eSIM when you land?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a second, my roommate wants to ask me something. I'll let you know when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Chloe, how do you share your location with someone? Mum wants to see when I'm driving home.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Open the map app, tap your little picture, then share location. You pick how long.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I make it just for tonight?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, there's an option for one hour or until you turn it off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll do until I turn it off. Otherwise I'll forget and she'll panic halfway down the motorway.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Classic. Send it to me too while you're at it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Could you open the window a little?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Your Portugal trip and that roaming bill. Carrier pass or local eSIM?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The travel pass. I don't want to mess with settings at the airport.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Totally reasonable. Just switch it on before you fly so you're covered the moment you land.
